name: 插件市场
description: dsh 里的可视化插件市场：浏览、搜索、一键安装社区插件。装了它之后，后续找插件就不用再回到这个面板。
descriptionEn: A visual plugin market inside dsh: browse, search, and install community plugins in one click. With it installed, finding the next plugin no longer means coming back to this panel.

name: 免费网页搜索
description: 免费的联网搜索与网页抓取通道：TinyFish、SearXNG、Tavily、Brave、Exa、百度千帆等十几个引擎按序 fallback，可拖动排序、每个引擎填多个 Key。走各家专用检索接口，不经过任何模型，因此一次搜索 0 模型 token，也不需要 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。
descriptionEn: A free web search and fetch channel: TinyFish, SearXNG, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Baidu Qianfan and a dozen engines in all, chained with automatic fallback, reorderable by drag, several keys per engine. It calls each engine's own search endpoint rather than a model, so a search costs zero model tokens and needs no DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

name: 输入预测
description: 每轮对话结束后，模型猜你接下来想说什么，以灰色幽灵文字显示在输入框里：按 → 接受，直接打字则忽略。预测模型默认跟随当前会话，也可以另配 ModelScope、硅基流动等 OpenAI 兼容模型。
descriptionEn: After each turn, the model guesses what you will say next and shows it as ghost text in the composer: press → to accept it, or just type to ignore it. Predictions use the session's model by default, or any OpenAI-compatible one such as ModelScope or SiliconFlow.

name: 会话信号
description: 让通知知道它在说哪个会话：一轮跑完、或者 dsh 停下来等授权 / 等审方案 / 等你回答时，从 dsh 自己的状态里读，而不是猜页面结构。点通知回到提问的那个会话，能一键回答的直接在通知上答。随应用发货，不联网。
descriptionEn: Lets a notification say which session it is about. It reads dsh's own session state rather than guessing at the page, so a finished turn — or a session stopped on an approval, a plan review or a question — names itself. Clicking the notification returns to that session, and what one press can answer is answered on the notification. Ships inside this app; installing it downloads nothing.

name: 厂商账号登录
description: 用你自己的订阅账号登录那些根本不发 API Key 的 AI 编程套餐：Claude Pro/Max/Team、ChatGPT Plus/Pro、GitHub Copilot、SuperGrok。在 dsh 设置界面里直接走各家官方的 OAuth / 设备码流程，令牌只留在本机。
descriptionEn: Sign in to AI coding plans that hand out no API key at all — Claude Pro/Max/Team, ChatGPT Plus/Pro, GitHub Copilot, SuperGrok — with your own subscription, straight from dsh's settings UI. It drives each vendor's own OAuth or device-code flow and the tokens stay on your machine.
